For 5141(S): A directory service object was deleted.
Appendix A: Security monitoring recommendations for many audit events

Important   For this event, also see Appendix A: Security monitoring recommendations for many audit events.If you need to monitor deletion of Active Directory objects with
specific classes, monitor for Class field with specific class name. For example, we recommend that you monitor for group policy objects deletions: groupPolicyContainer class.

If you need to monitor deletion of specific Active Directory objects, monitor for DN field with specific object name. For example, if you have critical Active Directory objects which
should not be deleted, monitor for their deletion.
